note: Australia has a relatively simple tariff structure for apparel. Most garments attract a 5% general duty rate. Preferential rates (Free) apply under FTAs with China (ChAFTA), Japan, Korea, ASEAN, and others. Goods under AUD 1,000 imported by consumers may be exempt from duty.
